description: getDataFromVectorsAndLatestNPeriods called with vectorId 0 - WDS rejects this outright with HTTP 406. The same happens for a non-positive latestN. This is why get_data must never forward a vectorId: 0 it got back from a lookup into a data-fetch call - see nonexistent_coordinate.json / census_series_info.json for where that 0 comes from.

body.message: vector id or latest N is negative or zero
